title: Solar Parts
subtitle: Cells, blend and cores
text:
PV Cells go into every panel up to Gold. Make them from glass, lapis, a Silicon Wafer and a Redstone Copper Ingot.

The Diamond panel uses Silicon-Lapis Blend instead, alloyed from a wafer and 3 lapis.

Each tier has its own core: a centre of Redstone Copper Ingot with 4 iron, copper or gold plates, or a diamond with 4 steel plates (the Diamond Core is on the panel page).
caption: Iron, Copper, Gold and Diamond
